title: Design System: P1 Academy & Legends Kart Series

display.purpose: Hero titles, fast speed headlines and principal section branding.

headline.purpose: Impact subheadings and card category titles.

body.purpose: Readable descriptions, instructions, regulations and administrative controls.

mono.purpose: Lap times, telemetry differences, points matrix and rank positions.

label.purpose: Category chips, table headers and button labels.

components.name: Score Cell
components.description: A three-decimal score with explicit victory, retained discard or absent marker.
components.css: .p1-score-cell { background: #1F2020; color: #E3E2E2; min-width: 56px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 700 11px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: center; border-radius: 0; } .p1-win { background: #EAEA00; color: #0D0E0F; } .p1-win small { color: #0D0E0F; font-weight: 900; }

components.name: Telemetry Card
components.css: .p1-stat-card { background: #1F2020; border: 1px solid #333333; border-top: 3px solid #EAEA00; padding: 20px; font-family: 'Geist', sans-serif; } .p1-stat-card .label { font-family: 'Anybody', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #CAC8AA; text-transform: uppercase; } .p1-stat-card strong { font-family: 'Anybody', sans-serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 32px; color: #E3E2E2; display: block; margin: 6px 0; }

narrative.overview: P1 Academy unifies high-performance kart training led by Brazilian champion André Felisberto with the immutable, auditable scoring of the Legends Kart Series. The visual system is sharp, flat, high-contrast, and rooted in motorsport precision.

rules.name: The Telemetry-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Maintain WCAG AA compliance on all dark backgrounds for numerical and analytical content.

rules.name: The State-Over-Color Rule
rules.body: Always use textual markers (V, D, -, DSQ, SF) alongside colors.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numeric Rule
rules.body: All times, deltas and points must be rendered with tabular mono typography.

rules.name: The Asphalt-Layering Rule
rules.body: Depth is achieved through solid tonal steps and 1px mechanical lines rather than blurred drop shadows.

dos: Do preserve three decimal places for official lap times and heat points.
Do provide tactile tap/keyboard access to score cell audit details.
Do maintain sticky pilot headers on mobile matrix scrolls.
Do explain discard formulas and tie-break criteria directly in context.
donts: Don't hide discarded results or fold them into unexplained aggregates.
Don't rely solely on hover interactions for critical telemetry details.
Don't compress large pilot rosters into unreadable mobile views.
Don't introduce non-functional decorative glows or multi-color gradients.
